description: This file defines a resolver class for configuring and managing a user table in an Angular application, including user CRUD operations, actions, and UI configurations.

classes.name: UsersTableConfigResolver
classes.description: An Angular service that resolves and configures the user table, handling user data operations, actions, and UI setup.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the entity table configuration based on route parameters and user authority, fetching necessary data and setting up the table.

methods.name: updateActionCellDescriptors
methods.description: Updates the action buttons available in each user table row based on authentication state.

methods.name: saveUser
methods.description: Saves a user entity, setting tenant and customer IDs, and cleaning up additional info before saving.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Opens a dialog to add a new user and returns the created user.

methods.name: openUser
methods.description: Navigates to the user detail page.

methods.name: loginAsUser
methods.description: Performs login as the specified user.

methods.name: displayActivationLink
methods.description: Displays an activation link dialog for the user.

methods.name: resendActivation
methods.description: Resends activation email to the user and shows a success notification.

methods.name: setUserCredentialsEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables user credentials and shows a notification.

methods.name: onUserAction
methods.description: Handles various user actions triggered from the UI.
